759040101.text: Maybe they've got something they need to work together on.

759040102.text: Is that so? Well, in that case, should I not stop making a ruckus, and instead wait patiently for their return?

759040103.text: I've got it. I'll prepare some snacks for them next time. I want all the little Saurians to know that my house is a good place for them to relax!

759040104.text: C'mon, you take some too. If you spot any lil' Saurians having a roadside rest, do share it with them.
